household_message.text: Usual charge for tomorrow, but no power from the grid tonight.

message_to_household: The gateway will charge the car to 80% by 07:30 tomorrow, using the usual 3.7 kW charger. Solar energy is valued at the feed‑in price of 0.123 EUR/kWh, so the plan is optimal.
